# svg-slides set: Neo-brutalism (`brutalist`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Neo-brutalist style: a high-saturation acid field (lime, hot pink, yellow), white cards, pure black text, 3 to 4 px black borders on every element, hard bottom-right offset shadows drawn as flat offset shapes (no blur), oversized Arial Black headlines over Courier New mono, bold asymmetric blocks with small tilts kept off the text slots. Dark theme: a near-black #0D0D0D field, white text, borders flip to white so they stay visible, hard shadows become solid acid-lime offsets. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set brutalist --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Neo-brutalism style specs (web and UI design write-ups): saturated flat background, white cards, thick black borders on every element, hard offset shadow with no blur, oversized heavy sans headlines with monospace accents.
- Gumroad-style neo-brutalist product pages and the "neubrutalism" UI component kits: pure black 2 to 4 px outlines, offset box shadows of 4 to 8 px, a bright accent per block.

Fonts: head `Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif`; sans `Courier New, Courier, monospace`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: acid field; a white card with a 4 px border and a hard offset shadow holds every text slot flush left; a tilted pink block, a yellow disc and a black bar break out of its right and bottom edges. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: hot-pink field; the chapter number sits oversized on a white card with a hard shadow; on the right the mono eyebrow, a two-line Arial Black title and an orientation line, all centred in the column around a short thick black bar, a tilted yellow block below. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: acid field; a large white card with a hard shadow holds three flush-left lines of Arial Black and the mono attribution under a thick rule; the eyebrow rides a pink tab on the card edge; a tilted yellow block and a disc break out below. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: acid field; mono eyebrow and an Arial Black heading over a thick black bar with a pink tab; a white body card and a pink key-point card with hard shadows on the left; a white graphic card with a hard shadow and caption on the right. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: acid field; mono eyebrow and a one-line Arial Black heading over a thick bar; a large white graphic card with a hard shadow; a pink takeaway card with a hard shadow and a yellow disc at its foot. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: hot-pink field; a large white card with a hard shadow holds a centred oversized two-line title, a short thick rule, up to three mono contact lines and a meta line, all centred; a tilted yellow block and a lime disc break out of its edges. |
